authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Official Planning Data publishes England Local Planning Authority administrative boundaries (337 LPAs) and documents entity IDs/geometry_entity spatial filtering. This is a materially different official source family from the prior ONS Open Geography catalog. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still contains no authoritative LPA name/entity ID, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, LAD/GSS code, or equivalent binding identifier, so selecting one of 337 LPAs would be a guess. No source-area geometry or parcel was accepted.
